deadline.value: Apply by 11:59pm PST, December 1, 2026. Fee-waiver requests are due by November 17, 2026 and waivers run out, so request early.
deadline.quote: 11:59pm, December 1, 2026, PST Application deadline for all PhDs.

also.quote: by November 17, 2026 Application fee waiver deadline is 10 business days before the department application deadline (December 1, 2026). | Fee waiver awards run out, so we encourage you to apply as soon as the application opens.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required and not considered.
gre_general.quote: Scores from the general or subject Graduate Record Examination (GRE) are not required for admission to any CEE Graduate Program.

supervisor.value: No advisor agreement is required; PhD applicants describe faculty whose research interests them in the statement of purpose.
supervisor.quote: Any faculty member’s research that is of specific interest to you

funding.value: The School of Engineering commits to full funding for all PhDs.
funding.quote: Stanford Engineering commits to full funding for all PhDs.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) is enough; no other graduate degree is required.
entry_route.quote: Applicants from institutions outside the U.S. must hold the equivalent of a U.S. bachelor’s degree from a college or university of recognized standing. | We do not require: A minimum GPA (grade point average) Particular fields of undergraduate/graduate study Other graduate degrees

notes: PhD applicants may be contacted for follow-up interviews.
